label: Bible Study
prompt: Children, _____ your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verse: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
note: Paul quotes the fifth commandment in the next verse — the one with the promise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Behold, I have graven thee upon the _____ of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verse: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
note: Not a note on the fridge — your name engraved on God's own palms. He can't open His hand without seeing you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become _____ of men.
verse: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
note: Jesus recruits from the docks: same nets, new catch — 'fishers of men.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old _____, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verse: Thus saith the LORD, Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
note: God offers Judah the well-worn road to rest — and the verse ends with their blunt reply: 'We will not walk therein.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only _____ of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verse: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
note: 'Only begotten' — the KJV's phrase for the unique Son, echoed two chapters later in John 3:16.
